text: Ava: quick sync thinking about a small persistent "policy crumb" inside the bulk-invite modal (below the title) that states org auth rules and links to settings. also want a one-click jump to invite-related audit entries after a batch completes. sketches in thread. Ben: policy crumb idea sounds promising less intrusive than a toggle and more visible than a tiny badge. placement: below title, full-width, subtle background. Clara: accessibility: crumb must be keyboard focusable and announced. recommend role="region" with aria-label="Authentication policy" plus the crumb link should have aria-describedby pointing to a hidden explanation: 'Single sign-on is required for this organization; changes are made in Organization settings.' Diego: implementation thought: crumb is an anchor to settings with ?focus=sso and a fragment to focus the SSO heading. sample: ``` SSO required Managed in Organization settings ``` Ava: legal confirmed no per-invite overrides. copy must be explicit. security prefers "required" not "enforced". product wants friendly tone. proposed visible text: "SSO required" and secondary screen-reader description explains policy. Clara: tooltip/popover should be accessible via keyboard (Enter/Space) and the content must be in DOM. prefer aria-describedby over aria-live for explanatory text. also ensure crumb contrast >= 4.5:1. Ben: visual variants: compact single-line crumb vs two-line crumb with secondary text. two-line may help reduce confusion. on mobile, make crumb stack neatly and keep tap target >=44px. Diego: engineering nit: use a query param ?from=invite-modal when linking to audit so we can show a small banner there and auto-filter to invites. audit link: /orgs/:id/audit?filter=invites&from=invite-modal. confirmation card after upload can include the deep link with a batch id. Ava: yes, confirmation CTA: "Open invite activity" -> include batch timestamp param so audit can highlight those rows. also add audit event metadata: sso_status: required. Ops requested exact key name. Clara: keyboard flow tests: tab order lands on crumb after title, Enter opens crumb tooltip or follows link; tooltip content announced via screen reader; tab continues into form fields; footer audit link reachable before close. test with NVDA and VoiceOver. Ben: slight copy tweak from legal: change screen-reader description to "Single sign-on is required for this organization; changes must be made in Organization settings." keeps it clear. Diego: will prototype HTML/CSS + small JS to handle deep-link focus (no animation). will add a11y attributes and a Cypress keyboard test. will ensure focus management on settings page: read ?focus=sso and focus the heading. Ava: one more UX detail: when the crumb link is present, show a small info icon that opens an inline popover with the explanation. popover must be dismissible with Escape and removed from DOM on close. Clara: confirm popover accessibility: role="dialog" or role="tooltip"? prefer dialog for longer content. ensure aria-modal not used (it's not a modal), and the dialog is labelled and described. also ensure it is reachable by keyboard. Diego: good call. I'll implement as a focusable popover with role="dialog" and aria-labelledby pointing to the header. keep content short. Ben: visual spacing: crumb height 40px, secondary text 13px, min-width 80px so line wraps predictably on narrow screens. info icon 16px with 44px tap target. Ava: CI: please queue a staging build once Diego pushes the prototype. we'll run a quick 2-admin usability session if staging looks good. CI-Bot: build queued for branch feat/policy-crumb-invite at 2167890300 https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/7777 Diego: noted. PR will include prototype, keyboard tests, and a short SR checklist. avoiding focus animations when deep-linking as requested. Ava: thanks team. final copy decision: visible crumb = "SSO required"; screen-reader description = "Single sign-on is required for this organization; changes must be made in Organization settings." audit event field = "sso_status: required". we'll validate on staging and iterate. :thumbsup:
